stage_A.name: mechanism and temperature screening
stage_A.geometry: one ideal cell, then actual multi-contact grain; no assumption of orientation independence
measurements: loss of contact under fixed displacement AND fixed force

primary_outcomes: postpeak release distance and residual drag
stage_B.reference: fresh groomed snow at its stable snow temperature; synthetic bed surface 50C

scope: full 450mm candidate bed with 300mm gouge requirement
material wear extractables and human environment assessment
manufacturing kg/h and functional service cost
stage_C.note: Requirements, not completed tests or certified operating limits

stop_or_switch: fixed-load mean drag stays high: revise contact phase rather than claim auxetic success
support disappears before useful edge load: reduce/retime retracting contacts or revise skeleton
hinge fails: change geometry or manufacturing route, not extrapolate 50 source cycles to seasons
wet friction changes release window: retest both support and release
